d: Short, messy lavender-purple hair with choppy layers and uneven bangs frames a youthful, adolescent face with wide-eyed, shimmering amethyst eyes. The slender build is dressed in a dark navy blue cropped halter top with a high collar, layered under a loose white oversized jacket, complemented by a black belt and a blue ribbon hanging from the neck. Signature details include large purple-tinted goggles pushed up onto the forehead, a black choker, small black earring studs, and a white ID badge clipped to the waist.
